head: MoodyRoutine brings Samsung-style Modes and Routines to Pixel phones
dek: MoodyRoutine is a free Android app that copies the idea of Samsung's Modes and Routines for other phones such as Google Pixels: modes like Sleep or Exercise switch on by time or when headphones connect and change your settings.
details: It combines more than 40 if-triggers and then-actions, and a mode can put your settings back when it ends. It needs Android 8.0 or newer and isn't on Google Play: it comes from F-Droid or its GitHub page. Android Authority notes it has no NFC tag or mobile network triggers yet, less smartwatch support than Samsung's version, and is a young project.
where: Android 8.0 and newer, through F-Droid or GitHub
means: If you moved from a Galaxy to a Pixel and miss Modes and Routines, this is a free way to get something similar.
todo: Install F-Droid, search for MoodyRoutine and tap Install; edit the Sleep and Exercise modes or add your own.
